A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/Sportway (incl. MyGame)

Platform pays for cameras and shares revenue

Sportway (incl. MyGame)Premium

Stockholm, Sweden · founded 2017 · active · www.sportway.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Platform pays for cameras and shares revenueFixed multi-lensDeployed in ItalyEvidence BQuote only

Sportway installs fixed AI cameras in arenas and on pitches at its own cost, produces every match automatically and distributes it through federation branded OTT platforms and consumer services such as MyGame in Norway sportway-03, sportway-04, sportway-11.

For Federations, leagues and media groups that want a whole tier of sport filmed and monetised without asking clubs to buy anything, plus the clubs inside those deals that receive cameras, coaching tools and a revenue share for free sportway-06, sportway-11, sportway-12. Individual clubs outside a federation agreement have no public way to buy in.

Sportway exists because Nordic ice hockey and handball federations wanted every game on a screen and no club would pay for a camera, so the company took on the capital cost and built a rights and subscription business around it, reaching about 2,500 cameras in 21 countries and 250,000 events a year by June 2026 sportway-01. It matters now because the June 2026 EUR 20 million round led by Giorgio Chiellini's Gamma Waves, the Studio Automated acquisition and the KNHB ClubhockeyTV deal show the model exporting beyond Scandinavia and into football adjacent sports sportway-01, sportway-11, sportway-15. It tells you the grassroots video market is splitting into a consumer camera business and a rights infrastructure business, and Sportway is the clearest European example of the second, with the Norwegian consent fights around MyGame as the cautionary tale sportway-08, sportway-09.

Price band Clubs pay nothing for cameras or installation under federation deals; consumers pay NOK 139/month or NOK 1,199/year for MyGame in Norway with 20% returned to a chosen club; Playsite and federation platform fees are not public sportway-05

Italy Sportway has a Milan operating base and a partnership with the Italian Ice Sports Federation (FISG) since autumn 2023 covering about 35 ice venues in ice hockey, figure skating, speed skating and curling, with a stated aim to expand beyond ice sports sportway-02.

The verdict

Look if You run a federation, league or regional media group and want an operator that will fund, install and run cameras across dozens or hundreds of venues in exchange for rights and a subscription model sportway-01, sportway-11. You are a club inside one of those agreements and want to understand what you get, which is free capture, a Team Account for tagging and a Player Account for clips, plus a possible revenue share sportway-06, sportway-14.

Skip if You are a single club or academy that wants to buy a camera this month, because Sportway publishes no per club price and works through federation and league agreements sportway-03, sportway-14. You need a portable camera for away games and tournaments, since the system is a fixed installation wired to mains and network sportway-16, sportway-12.

Watch-outs

  • MyGame's Norwegian rollout was paused by Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim and Tromsø municipalities in early 2023 and the Norwegian Data Protection Authority said streaming of children's sport would be hard to do lawfully under the then current setup, so any deployment involving under 18s needs a consent design agreed with the local regulator first sportway-08, sportway-09.
  • In December 2022 people were filmed at handball and volleyball training without their knowledge because cameras stayed active outside scheduled matches, which is a design risk of always installed cameras sportway-10.
  • The parent company Sportway Media Group AB reported revenue of SEK 756 thousand and a loss after financial items of SEK 14.2 million for 2024 at holding level, and consolidated group accounts are not visible in the free registry view, so scale claims cannot be cross checked against audited numbers sportway-17.
  • The camera hardware is described only in general terms as multi lens security grade cameras with proprietary AI, so resolution, frame rate and tracking behaviour must be checked on a live stream in your sport before signing sportway-16.
  • Club revenue share is documented for MyGame in Norway at 20% of subscription revenue, and no comparable figure is published for ClubhockeyTV or other markets sportway-06, sportway-12.

Products

  • Sportway fixed AI camera system (camera). Multi lens fixed installation with proprietary AI framing, wired to power and network, installed and owned by Sportway sportway-14, sportway-16.
  • Playsite (platform). White label web TV and app platform with pay per view and subscription billing, TV casting and automatic scheduling from federation databases sportway-14.
  • Team Account and Player Account (add-on). Coaching tool with live tagging and video markup, and player tool with personal highlights, statistics and recruitment reels sportway-14.
  • Studio App (app). iOS and Android app for manual smartphone production of matches where no fixed camera exists, launched Q4 2022 sportway-14.
  • Low Latency Feed and Situation Room (add-on). Sub five second feed for betting and data partners, and a high resolution playback tool with joystick zoom for player safety review sportway-14.
  • MyGame (platform). Norwegian consumer service covering handball, football, ice hockey, floorball, volleyball and basketball at over 500 venues, sold through TV 2 Play sportway-04.
  • Studio Automated (platform). AI software for automated and remote multicamera production and real time event detection, acquired with Broadcast Solutions in April 2026 sportway-15.

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
Sportway is built for a federation or league that wants every match in a competition tier filmed and distributed, and it fits clubs only as beneficiaries of such a deal sportway-11, sportway-12. The company reports 200,000 ice hockey matches a year, 2,000 football matches a season and 20,000 matches across floorball, handball and volleyball, so football is a minority sport in its portfolio today sportway-03. Coaching and player tools exist as Team Account and Player Account layers on top of the broadcast feed sportway-14.
Capture quality
MyGame describes multi camera, multi lens rigs that film the whole playing area and let the AI frame a 16:9 broadcast picture, with security grade cameras chosen for the job sportway-16. Sportway does not publish resolution or frame rate for its fixed cameras, and the Studio Automated acquisition adds AI controlled PTZ cameras for higher production tiers sportway-15. Judge the output from a live ClubhockeyTV or MyGame stream in your sport, since no spec sheet exists sportway-12.
Automation accuracy
The AI locates the ball or puck, detects active players and the playing surface, and frames the shot following manual camera operator principles, with 5 to 25 matches of training footage per sport and venue type sportway-16. Since April 2026 Sportway owns Studio Automated's real time event detection, which generates highlights, clips and replays during matches sportway-15. No independent accuracy measurement is public.
Multi-angle and stitching
Rigs combine several cameras and lenses to cover the whole field, and the AI selects the framing from that panorama sportway-16. Studio Automated adds multicamera automation for remote production in football, ice hockey, basketball and handball sportway-15. Details of stitching resolution or the number of virtual angles offered to viewers are not published.
Latency and live readiness
The whole business is live first, with matches streamed to federation platforms and to TV 2 Play in Norway sportway-04, sportway-14. Sportway sells a low latency feed with glass to glass delay under five seconds for betting and data partners sportway-14. Standard viewer latency is not published.
Reliability and resilience
The system runs about 2,500 cameras across 21 countries and 250,000 events a year, which is the strongest available signal of operational maturity sportway-01. Cameras are wired to mains and to on site or datacentre computers, with no batteries or phone hotspots involved sportway-16. Public reliability complaints are not visible because the service is sold to federations and consumers review the TV 2 Play app, so the camera itself gets no public reviews.
Portability and install
Installation is a one time fixed mount per rink or pitch, with the club providing power and internet and Sportway supplying and installing all equipment at its own cost sportway-06, sportway-12. Nothing is portable, so away fixtures at unequipped venues are not captured. The Studio App lets a person produce a match manually from a smartphone where no fixed camera exists sportway-14.
Connectivity and bandwidth
Cameras connect by cable to a local or datacentre computer and the club supplies a fast internet line, with hockey.nl stating a fast connection is one of the two things a club must provide sportway-16, sportway-12. Bandwidth requirements are not published.
Workflow and UX
Matches are scheduled automatically from federation databases, so clubs do not start or stop recordings sportway-14. Coaches tag events in the Team Account and players clip and share from the Player Account, both web based sportway-14. Viewers use the federation web TV or the MyGame app inside TV 2 Play sportway-04.
Analysis layer
Team Account offers real time tagging of shots, goals, turnovers and face offs plus video markup for player feedback sportway-14. Player Account gives a personal highlights library, statistics and recruitment reel creation sportway-14. This is a broadcast first product and it lacks the tactical drawing tools and fitness data of dedicated analysis platforms.
Integrations
Auto scheduling integrates with federation and league match databases sportway-14. In Norway the player opt out runs through the national Min Idrett registration system, which shows deep federation IT integration sportway-06. Public APIs for third party analysis tools are not documented.
Distribution and OTT
Distribution is the core product, through Playsite white label OTT with pay per view and subscription billing, browser and mobile apps and TV casting sportway-14. Recent examples include ClubhockeyTV inside Hockey.nl, Volleybal TV for Nevobo, WKBLive.tv for English ice hockey clubs and the Prva CFL platform in Montenegro sportway-11, sportway-18. In Norway, distribution is through TV 2 Play at NOK 139 a month sportway-05.
Data access and ownership
Sportway's model is that the operator holds the rights and the platform, and MyGame states that videos are removed after two to three months depending on the tournament sportway-06. Player Account allows clip editing and social sharing, and full match download rights for clubs are not documented publicly sportway-14. Clubs entering a deal should negotiate raw footage access and retention in the contract.
Privacy and compliance
MyGame streams only from the 15 year age class, requires athletes to be at least 13, lets any player opt out anonymously through Min Idrett, blocks filming of players with protected addresses by default and shares data controller duties with the Norwegian sports confederation after working with the Data Protection Authority sportway-06. That framework was built after municipalities in Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim and Tromsø paused cameras in 2023 and after training sessions were filmed without notice in 2022 sportway-08, sportway-09, sportway-10. For ClubhockeyTV the KNHB requires advance information to players, coaches and officials and gives clubs consent guidelines, and no automatic blurring feature is described anywhere sportway-11, sportway-12.
Security
Not assessable from public sources. MyGame refers to a two level security solution for personal data without technical detail sportway-06.
Pricing and TCO
Clubs inside a federation agreement pay nothing for hardware, installation or operation, and supply only power and internet sportway-06, sportway-12. Consumers in Norway pay NOK 139 a month or NOK 1,199 a year, with 20% of subscription revenue paid to the club the subscriber selects, and MyGame reports NOK 7.9 million paid out to Norwegian sport sportway-05, sportway-04. Federation platform fees, revenue splits outside Norway and any per club option are not public, so total cost for a federation is a negotiated number.
Support and service
Sportway runs country teams, with a named Italy project manager and a Sportway NL entity with its own CEO for the Dutch rollout sportway-02, sportway-11. The Swedish switchboard and info address are the public contact points sportway-03. Service levels for clubs are not published.
Company health and roadmap
Sportway raised EUR 20 million in June 2026 at a EUR 92 million post money valuation, led by Gamma Waves with existing shareholders participating, to fund international expansion, product development and acquisitions sportway-01. It bought Studio Automated with Broadcast Solutions in April 2026 and signed EuroHockey, Spanish basketball, Swedish futsal and Swedish handball deals between June and September 2026 sportway-15, sportway-18. The holding company showed a SEK 14.2 million loss for 2024 with 14 employees at holding level, so the group is still investing ahead of profit sportway-17.
Evidence and references
Reference customers named in primary material include the Swedish and Finnish ice hockey associations, KNHB, Nevobo, the Norwegian tennis and padel federation, FISG in Italy and the Norwegian sports confederation through MyGame sportway-01, sportway-02, sportway-06, sportway-18. Published football references are limited to Montenegro's Prva CFL OTT platform and 2,000 matches a season without named clubs sportway-03, sportway-18.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Not assessable from public sources. Norwegian coverage records club leaders defending the service when municipalities switched cameras off, which is a satisfaction signal from administrators, and analysts have left no public record sportway-08.
Edge versus cloud
Cameras feed a computer on site or in a datacentre where the AI framing runs, and MyGame describes this as cable connected processing with no compute in the camera sportway-16. Studio Automated brings server side real time event detection sportway-15. Data residency for stored video is not published.
Accessibility and languages
The corporate site is in English and country pages exist for Italy and Norway, while MyGame is in Norwegian and ClubhockeyTV is delivered in Dutch inside Hockey.nl sportway-02, sportway-04, sportway-12. App language lists and accessibility features are not published.
Upgrade path
Within a deal, clubs can move from automated fixed capture to Studio App manual production and up to AI PTZ multicamera production from Studio Automated sportway-14, sportway-15. Coaching layers, low latency betting feeds and the Situation Room safety review tool are add ons on the same platform sportway-14.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the opt out flow end to end, since the anonymous Min Idrett reservation is the most mature consent mechanism in this market and it should be a contract requirement anywhere minors are filmed sportway-06. Test the real time highlight and replay generation now that Studio Automated is in house sportway-15. Ask for the club revenue share formula and compare it with MyGame's published 20% sportway-06.

Company

Ownership and funding Sportway Media Group AB was formed in October 2022 by merging Swedish Sportway AB with Norwegian MyGame Group AS at a valuation of about EUR 60 million, and it owns Sportway AB, Live Arena Sports AB, MyGame Group AS and 51% of MyGame Norway AS, with TV 2 and Amedia holding the other 49% of the Norwegian operating company sportway-07. In June 2026 the company raised EUR 20 million (SEK 200 million) led by Gamma Waves, the fund founded by Giorgio Chiellini, with existing shareholders participating, at a SEK 1 billion post money valuation sportway-01, sportway-18. Founders Jonas Persson and Daniel Franck remain chairman and CEO sportway-01, sportway-17.

Financials Holding company accounts for 2024 show revenue of SEK 756 thousand, a loss after financial items of SEK 14.2 million and 14 employees, and consolidated group figures are not visible in the free registry view sportway-17. Group revenue is not public.

Scale, company-stated About 2,500 AI camera systems in 21 countries, 70 plus federations and leagues and 250,000 plus live events a year as of June 2026 sportway-01. MyGame covers over 500 Norwegian venues and has paid NOK 7.9 million to Norwegian sport sportway-04. Sportway Italy equipped about 35 ice venues and projected 3,000 streams in the 2023 to 2024 season sportway-02.
